decision.observation: S-only worked: 9 mph in gear R, clearing the pine. The car is now further back down-frame on open grass, with the gravel road running diagonally up-left and two pines ahead-left of the nose.
decision.hypothesis: Reverse gave a clear run at the road with no trunk in the immediate path; a W+A beat should swing the nose left and carry the car across 2-3 widths of grass onto the gravel.
decision.memory: S-only 1.0 s produced 9 mph in R and clean separation from the pine — reversing out of a trunk pin remains the reliable escape on this bend. Pine at roughly x=0.5,y=0.95 of the car's left-ahead is the main obstacle.
